instruction: Play the video frames hidden in the heron image using steganography and export them as an MP4 file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it assumes video data is hidden in the image using steganography, which cannot be verified. GIMP also lacks steganography decoding and video export capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - steganography requires specific decoding methods and keys that cannot be assumed
GIMP lacks steganography decoding capabilities to extract hidden video frames
GIMP cannot export MP4 video files even if frames could be extracted
No programmatic way exists to verify whether hidden video data was successfully extracted and exported
The 'infeasible()' evaluator function is the semantically correct choice for tasks that cannot be verified
